turns.text: I'm interviewing for a team lead job and the panel includes two of my current colleagues. That's so awkward.

turns.speaker: moshi

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then be professional and treat it like a real interview, even though they know you. Don't skip details because you assume they already know.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: we did together, or is that weird?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Mention them. Concrete examples they witnessed are actually powerful, because they can confirm them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Stay friendly before and after. However it goes, you'll still be working together on Monday.
